messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-01-22, the product catalog deploy window remains weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team observed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- On 2025-11-04, the Ember team observed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-04]
- At the Boreal standup on 2025-11-03, it was decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- On 2025-12-25, the Atlas team observed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2025-12-31, the Atlas team observed that the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- At the Cinder standup on 2026-01-30, it was decided that authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- Tomasz was on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03, but left it on 2025-07-30 when he moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is back on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Tomasz had the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team but is off rotation as of 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The webhook dispatcher depends on the bus for outbound events, so it is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-29]
- On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook. [valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
- The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team observes a no-deploy Friday, with no deployments on Fridays. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- The reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; as of 2025-09-23 it uses the bus as its source. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- During INC-2026-009, the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
